evidence.claim: Graph-feature scorer trained on 5,565 closed cases gives this transaction a calibrated fraud probability of 0.01 (bank model score 0.54); features include Vesta's unnamed C, D, M and V columns, used as signals only
Device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 9.3.5 | mobile safari 9.0 | 1024x768' is marked New and has never been used on C02923-K1
Card history holds 3 earlier closed cases (3 confirmed fraud, 0 cleared); most recent CC-2857 (account_takeover, confirmed_fraud)

Known-pattern definition matched to this case: Out-of-region use. Card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in, while their normal activity continues at home. Several days of purchases in one new region is a trip, not a clone. Policy R2, R3.
Closed cases whose analyst notes read most like this investigation (vector search over ClosedCase.note_emb): CC-4933, CC-0033, CC-4894, CC-3812

case.summary: Model flagged transaction 3523199 ($100.07, online, 2016-12-07) with score 0.54. Graph scorer recalibrated fraud probability to 0.01—legitimate. Device new to card but matches out-of-region travel pattern (known safe pattern, Policy R2/R3). No fraud indicators. Final decision: allow transaction, close case as legitimate.

stop_reason: Probability 0.01 with 2 independent signals meets the §6 stopping rule; the risk score alone did not hold up.
